name: CogentNexus OpenClaw Bridge
description: Ticket-first OpenClaw bridge for CogentNexus Host-managed continuity, durable execution, recovery, context handoff, and verified delivery.

autoResume.description: Enable bounded Direct recovery after a resumable interruption.

directDeliverySettleMs.description: Quiet period after fallback message_sent receipts before a direct Ticket is considered delivered.

directDeliveryTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time a response-ready direct Ticket may remain without confirmed final delivery before durable recovery.

outboxDeliveryTimeoutMs.description: Retry age for a scheduled terminal delivery that never receives a delivery receipt.

postCompactionResumeDelayMs.description: Legacy compatibility delay. v0.9 context safety owns Direct recovery after compaction and does not wake solely because the user chose Compact History.

contextSafetyEnabled.description: Enable pre-inference context pressure admission and durable background compaction for ticketed owner sessions.

contextSoftRatio.description: Optional projected context ratio that defers owner inference to bounded recovery before overflow. Defaults adapt to the model window.

contextHardRatio.description: Projected context ratio that authorizes deterministic hard transcript trimming if semantic compaction cannot reclaim enough headroom.

contextMinimumHeadroomTokens.description: Minimum headroom kept before owner inference; automatically capped relative to the active model window.

contextMaintenancePollMs.description: Poll interval for human-authorized context maintenance rows.

contextMaintenanceMaxAttempts.description: Maximum automatic context-maintenance attempts for one session generation before maintenance stops until a new human request authorizes another attempt.

contextCompactionTimeoutMs.description: Gateway RPC timeout for semantic context compaction.

contextHardTrimMaxLines.description: First deterministic last-lines fallback when a hard-pressure session cannot be made safe by semantic compaction. OpenClaw archives the prior transcript.

contextRecoveryHoldPollMs.description: Polling interval while a committed Direct Recovery waits for its same-generation context-maintenance hold to settle.

contextRecoveryHoldMaxMs.description: Maximum bounded wait for context maintenance before the hidden recovery attempt fails and returns to durable retry policy.

recoveryOrderPollMs.description: Polling interval while a claimed hidden Direct Recovery waits behind an older accepted Direct Recovery in the same session generation.

syntheticPromptInlineChars.description: Maximum internal hidden-worker payload kept inline before exact content is externalized to a durable SHA-256 chunk bundle.

syntheticPromptChunkChars.description: Maximum characters per deterministic chunk for an externalized internal hidden-worker payload.

autoRotate.description: Opt in to a clean TaskFlow/Codex worker for ROTATE handoffs. Disabled by default.

workspaceDir.description: Workspace containing CogentNexus durable state and workflow completion outboxes.

autoWorkflowCompletion.description: Automatically wake the bound owner when a workflow reaches a terminal state.

enforcedMode.description: Enforce owner/session and managed workflow authority boundaries.

preInferenceAdmission.description: Route obvious durable owner requests before the selected conversational model receives the prompt.

durableWorkerModel.description: Ollama model used by automatically compiled bounded workflow components.

ticketFirst.description: Commit every eligible owner message to SQLite before inference. Host-managed installs enable this by default.

ticketDatabasePath.description: Optional SQLite ticket database path. Defaults under workspace .cogent/runtime.

ticketDispatchLimit.description: Maximum Tickets claimed per dispatch tick.

ticketLeaseMs.description: Ticket worker lease and heartbeat extension.

ticketMinimumFreeMemoryBytes.description: Minimum observed free memory before Ticket dispatch.

ticketMinimumFreeDiskBytes.description: Minimum observed free disk before Ticket dispatch.

ticketMaximumAttempts.description: Maximum Ticket claim attempts before a retryable failure becomes terminal.

knowledgeEnabled.description: Enable the additive SQLite Experience/Lesson store. Retrieval remains optional and never controls durable execution.

externalResearchEnabled.description: Enable bounded external-research job storage and evidence ingestion. Network access still requires an explicit capability adapter.
